Dear Indeed, please fix the listings before candidates start applying for jobs on Mars. 😂🚀

To everyone still job hunting the week of Thanksgiving:

The silence after you apply is usually not about you.

This time of year, a lot of it is timing:
Next year's budget isn't signed off yet, so the role is on hold.
The hiring manager is out until Monday.
Interviews got pushed into December.
The job got hundreds of applications in its first few days and the shortlist filled fast.

None of that is a verdict on you.
